Embedding Models for Stance-Aware Argument Retrieval

Angelo Sparacino    Francesca Toni    Adam Dejl
Abstract

In computational argumentation, obtaining arguments that explicitly support or attack given claims is a critical precursor to downstream reasoning tasks. When these supporting and attacking arguments are to be retrieved using semantic search methods, they need to be assessed for topic-relevance to the claims of interest as well as for correctness of their (positive or negative) stance towards the claims. In this paper we explore how dense embedding models (hereafter, models), powering modern retrieval pipelines, can serve as the basis of semantic search incorporating this dual assessment. We show experimentally that existing models struggle with asymmetric reasoning, exhibiting a strong bias toward topical overlap while ignoring instructional stance. We also show that correcting this bias via contrastive training triggers a new failure mode where models over-correct, over-fixating on polarity keywords (e.g., “supports” or “refutes”) at the expense of the semantic topic. We thus introduce diagnostic word-ablation metrics to quantify this phenomenon and propose a data-centric solution. By implementing a balanced argument curriculum alongside LLM-augmented, stance-inverted arguments, we force the (embedding) models to learn deeper directional logic rather than exploiting superficial lexical shortcuts. Our evaluation demonstrates that, for sufficiently powerful models, this approach can alleviate the observed overcorrection, achieving further improvements in stance-aware argument retrieval.

argument retrieval ,stance-aware retrieval ,embedding models ,contrastive learning ,data augmentation

1 Introduction

The modern digital landscape is associated with an unprecedented proliferation of data. To process this information, the field of computational argumentation relies heavily on automated argument mining pipelines Lawrence and Reed (2019b). A foundational prerequisite to these tasks is the accurate retrieval of evidence that explicitly supports or attacks a claim. While Large Language Models (LLMs) are often employed in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Lewis et al. (2020) to ground their reasoning in external evidence, the efficacy of these pipelines is bottlenecked by their retrieval component.

Modern dense retrievers utilise a bi-encoder architecture to map textual sequences into a continuous, high-dimensional vector space Karpukhin et al. (2020), quantifying semantic relevance through spatial proximity. However, applying pre-trained embedding models (hereafter, models) to the asymmetric demands of (attacking/supporting) argument retrieval demonstrates that they struggle on this task. Indeed, while instruction-tuned embedding models Su et al. (2023); Zhang et al. (2025); Xiao et al. (2024) excel at fetching documents based on general subject matter, their internal mechanisms often default to superficial topical matching. These models heavily rely on semantic overlap while largely ignoring relational stance Sinha et al. (2021), as illustrated in Figure 1 (left).

Here, given an instruction such as “Find statements rejecting” and a claim relating to some topic, models frequently retrieve arguments that perfectly match the topic but directly violate the instruction.

Having evaluated this problem experimentally (Section 4), we initially attempt to correct this behaviour through contrastive tuning, but observe that this may cause the embedding space to undergo a phenomenon we call ‘topical collapse’. During optimisation, the model shifts its representational capacity away from the underlying subject matter and over-fixates on explicit polarity keywords.

To address this problem as well as the general limitations of embedding models on the stance-aware argument retrieval task, we investigate several targeted interventions aiming to achieve balance between topic- and stance-sensitivity (Section 5). The primary contributions of this work are as follows:

  • •

    We conduct an extensive experimental evaluation of embedding models’ performance on the stance-aware argument retrieval task, including through novel diagnostic metrics of Relative Instruction/Claim Sensitivity (RIS/RCS) and Directional Impact (DI). The metrics quantify the effects of specific input text portions on the resulting similarity through word ablation, providing deeper insight about model focus and the topical collapse phenomenon.

  • •

    We introduce targeted interventions for stance-aware retrieval, aiming to improve the performance of embedding models on this task while mitigating topical collapse. This includes devising a refined fine-tuning curriculum as well as exploring hybrid search approaches.

Overall, our experiments show that while base embedding models perform poorly on stance-aware retrieval, their performance can be substantially improved through targeted fine-tuning. To enable reuse by the research community, our codebase, datasets and models are publicly available11 1 Code: https://github.com/as9122/cmna26-stance-aware-text-retrieval, datasets and models: https://huggingface.co/collections/as9122/cmna26-stance-aware-text-retrieval..

2 Related Work

Argument Mining Argument mining Lawrence and Reed (2019a) aims to identify, in text, arguments, their components, and dialectical relations (notably of attack or support) among them. In this paper we focus on relation-based argument mining Carstens and Toni (2015), specifically on retrieving arguments supporting or attacking given claims. Rather than using LLMs to perform this task, e.g., as in Gorur et al. (2025), we rely on embedding models.

Dense Retrieval and Foundation Models Modern retrieval systems rely on the bi-encoder architecture to semantically match queries to related documents. In this framework, a query and a document are processed independently by neural embedding models to generate high-dimensional, real-valued dense vectors. This allows relevance to be evaluated mathematically, typically via cosine similarity, and enables computationally efficient offline indexing Xu et al. (2026).

However, static document embeddings introduce a “representational bottleneck” Nogueira and Cho (2019) because they must compress all possible semantic interpretations into a single vector. To bypass this limitation, instruction-tuned models like Instructor Su et al. (2023), and more recently, decoder-only foundation models Zhang et al. (2025), were developed. By prepending a natural language instruction to the query, these architectures condition the embedding space to prioritise specific semantic features based on explicit user intent.

To train these foundation models for retrieval tasks, the standard industry practice relies on contrastive learning methodologies such as Multiple Negatives Ranking Loss (MNRL) Henderson et al. (2017), an adaptation of InfoNCE van den Oord et al. (2018). During training, MNRL forces the model to maximise similarity between a query and a positive document, while simultaneously minimising similarity with a batch of negative documents.

Lexical Bias and Instruction-Aware Retrieval While the architectural transition to foundation models suggests an inherent capacity for complex reasoning, empirical stress testing reveals that models often regress to a “bag-of-words” heuristic. Rather than processing an instruction as a logical constraint, models treat it merely as a source of additional keywords to be matched Oh et al. (2024). Benchmarks such as FollowIR Weller et al. (2025) and InstructIR Oh et al. (2024) have quantified this weakness, demonstrating the sensitivity of retrieval models to phrasing and surface-level lexical patterns.

在文本检索的背景下，文档子集也可以充当“硬底片”In the context of text retrieval, subsets of documents can also act as “hard negatives”Zhuang et al. (2025)。对于指令调整模型，这些通常是与查询主题高度重叠但明确违反指令的文档（例如，当指示查找支持论点时反驳气候变化的文档）。由于嵌入空间主要是词汇重叠，因此“负面”文档通常包含与真正的“正面”文档相同或更高密度的查询项，导致其嵌入与查询过于接近。解决此问题的常见方法是硬负挖掘，其中检索模型在训练期间有意暴露于硬负文档. For instruction-tuned models, these are often documents that share high topical overlap with the query but explicitly violate the instruction (e.g., a document refuting climate change when instructed to find supporting arguments). Because the embedding space is dominated by lexical overlap, the “negative” document often contains an equal or higher density of query terms than a true “positive” document, causing its embedding to be undesirably close to the query. A common approach to address this issue is hard-negative mining, where a retrieval model is intentionally exposed to hard-negative documents during trainingKarpukhin et al. (2020); Xiong et al. (2021); Moreira et al. (2025)。该策略可以选择与其他以数据为中心的方法（例如平衡采样）结合使用. This strategy can be optionally combined with other data-centric methods such as balanced samplingHofstätter et al. (2021)和LLM数据增强and LLM data augmentationBonifacio et al. (2022); Dai et al. (2023); Ouyang et al. (2022); Zheng et al. (2023).

3 任务制定和实验设置Task Formulation and Experimental Setup

在本节中，我们概述了立场感知论证检索的考虑任务，同时还描述了一般实验设置和评估指标。这一背景将有助于我们后续分析评估最先进的嵌入模型在立场感知参数检索方面的性能，以及我们对提高这种性能的技术的研究。In this section, we provide an overview of the considered task of stance-aware argument retrieval while also describing the general experimental setup and evaluation metrics. This background will be helpful for our later analysis evaluating the performance of state-of-the-art embedding models on stance-aware argument retrieval as well as our investigation of techniques to improve this performance.

4 基线模型评估Baseline Model Evaluation

4.1 基准性能Baseline Performance

考虑到立场感知检索任务，我们首先评估基本指令跟随嵌入模型及其使用基线微调策略优化的对应模型的性能。该策略使用由使用 MNRL 的硬负三元组组成的同质课程来优化模型。结果（如图Given the considered stance-aware retrieval task, we first evaluate the performance of base instruction-following embedding models and their counterparts optimised using a baseline fine-tuning strategy. This strategy optimises the models using a homogeneous curriculum comprised of hard-negative triplets using MNRL. The results (in Figure2）显示模型之间存在显着的性能差异：) show substantial performance differences between the models:

  • •

However, it remained the lowest-performing architecture overall, exhibiting a pronounced spike in semi-hard negatives on the TFU Validation sets (constituting 27.1% of the retrieved items on GPT-5 data).

On the held-out training data partition, the fine-tuned model achieved a Precision@R of 0.95, reducing the originally high stance error down from 39.7% to 2%.

总的来说，我们发现，尽管被指示了所需的论点立场，但所评估的基本嵌入模型都无法可靠地执行立场感知论点检索。虽然微调成功地抑制了 Qwen 和 Instructor-XL 的立场错误，但它也引发了检索半硬负数（与立场匹配但与主题不匹配的文档）的相关增加。在 GPT-5 验证分叉中，Qwen 的半硬负率增加了一倍多，从 5.6% 增加到 12.9%。对于 Instructor-XL，这种失败更为明显，从 7.5% 增加到 22.6%。这些结果表明，针对同质数据集的标准对比优化（即所有三重否定都是硬否定）迫使模型过度纠正，过度关注论证立场，同时部分忽略主题。我们将在下一小节中详细阐述这一现象。Overall, we find that none of the evaluated base embedding models perform stance-aware argument retrieval reliably, despite being instructed about the desired argument stance. While fine-tuning successfully suppressed stance errors for Qwen and Instructor-XL, it also triggered an associated increase in retrieving semi-hard negatives (documents matching the stance but not the topic). On the GPT-5 validation split, Qwen’s semi-hard negative rate more than doubled, from 5.6% to 12.9%. For Instructor-XL, this failure was even more pronounced, increasing from 7.5% to 22.6%. These results suggest that standard contrastive optimisation against a homogeneous dataset (i.e., with all triplet negatives being hard negatives) forces models to over-correct, unduly focusing on argument stance while partially neglecting the topic. We elaborate on this phenomenon in the following subsection.

在另一个实验中，我们测试是否可以通过使用现成的交叉编码器重排序器来减轻双编码器嵌入模型的一般缺点。交叉编码器通过在连接的查询和文档中应用完全自注意力来计算语义相似度分数，并且可用于细化双编码器最初检索的文档的排名。这种设置通常用于提高检索管道的可靠性In an additional experiment, we test whether the general shortcomings of bi-encoder embedding models can be mitigated by using an off-the-shelf cross-encoder reranker. Cross-encoders compute semantic similarity scores by applying full self-attention across the concatenated query and document, and can be used to refine the ranking of documents originally retrieved by a bi-encoder. Such a setup is commonly used to improve the reliability of retrieval pipelinesPandit et al. (2026)。然而，实证评估表明，现成的重新排序器无法完成我们的立场感知论证检索任务。当应用于基础 Qwen3-Embedding-8B 基础模型时，重新排序器 Qwen3-Reranker-8B 的改进可以忽略不计，但姿态误差仍然很高（从 39.7% 略微下降到 38.5%）。更令人担忧的是，将候选池从微调双编码器模型传递到基础重排序器会主动抵消微调后的性能改进。由于交叉编码器依赖于其自身预先训练的词汇偏差，因此其应用将 TFU 训练上的 Precision@R 从 0.95 降低到 0.645，并将姿态误差增加到 35.3%。这些结果表明，即使应用计算​​要求较高的重排序器也可能不足以实现立场感知参数检索的高性能，促使我们专注于直接改进双编码器模型。. However, empirical evaluation demonstrates that the off-the-shelf reranker fails at our task of stance-aware argument retrieval. When applied to the base Qwen3-Embedding-8B base model, the reranker, Qwen3-Reranker-8B, yielded negligible improvements, with stance errors remaining high (dropping marginally from 39.7% to 38.5%). More alarmingly, passing a candidate pool from the fine-tuned bi-encoder model to the base reranker actively counteracted the post-fine-tuning performance improvements. Because the cross-encoder relies on its own pre-trained lexical biases, its application reduced Precision@R on TFU Training from 0.95 to 0.645 and increased the stance error to 35.3%. These results show that even the application of a computationally demanding reranker may be insufficient for achieving high performance on stance-aware argument retrieval, prompting us to focus on improving bi-encoder models directly.

4.2 局部崩溃Topical Collapse

虽然检索指标表明，Qwen 和 Instructor-XL 等模型在微调后姿态误差明显减少，但半硬负数的相关增加值得进一步研究。为了诊断原因，我们使用单词消融指标来评估单词级别的相似性变化。附录中给出了所有模型/数据集的单词消融指标的综合结果While the retrieval metrics demonstrated a clear reduction in stance error for models like Qwen and Instructor-XL after fine-tuning, the associated rise in semi-hard negatives warrants further investigation. To diagnose the cause, we use our word ablation metrics to evaluate word-level similarity shifts. Comprehensive results for word ablation metrics across all models/datasets are given in AppendixE.

首先，我们评估方向影响（DI），以确认训练成功地使模型对立场逻辑更加敏感。在基础模型中，消除指令姿态动词导致平均相似度接近于零（例如，Qwen 的 TFU 训练中的硬负数为 0.036），这表明基础模型倾向于在很大程度上忽略关系约束。相反，经过微调后，硬负面的平均 DI 大幅增加（例如，Qwen 的 TFU 训练中为 0.238），而正面论点的平均 DI 大幅下降（例如 Qwen 的 TFU 训练中为 -0.199）。这表明，对于微调后的模型，立场关键字会导致查询嵌入更加接近肯定论点，同时远离硬否定。First, we evaluate the Directional Impact (DI) to confirm that training succeeded in making models more sensitive to stance logic. In the base models, ablating instruction stance verbs caused a near-zero similarity shift on average (e.g., 0.036 for hard negatives from TFU Training for Qwen), showing the base models’ tendency to largely ignore relational constraints. Conversely, after fine-tuning, the average DI for hard negatives has substantially increased (e.g., to 0.238 on TFU Training for Qwen) while the average DI for positive arguments has substantially decreased (e.g., to -0.199 on TFU Training for Qwen). This indicates that, for the fine-tuned models, the stance keywords cause the query embeddings to draw substantially closer to the positive arguments while moving further away from the hard negatives.

然而，评估模型的 RIS 和 RCS 揭示了这种立场焦点的缺点。以 Qwen 作为代表性示例，该模型的基础版本表现出强烈的声明偏差，导致 TFU 训练参数数据集上的平均 RCS 为 75.2%。经过对比微调后，模型在数据集上的平均 RIS 增加到 36%，相应的 RCS 减少到 64%。这表明微调已将模型的重点转移到立场指令上，但考虑到半硬负检索的相关增加，这可能是以准确表示主题为代价的。图 1 中显示的完整 RCS 分布证实了这一点However, evaluating the model’s RIS and RCS reveals the drawbacks of this stance focus. Considering Qwen as a representative example, the base version of the model exhibited a strong claim bias, resulting in an average RCS of 75.2% on the TFU Training Arguments dataset. Following contrastive fine-tuning, the model’s average RIS on the dataset increased to 36%, with the corresponding RCS decrease to 64%. This suggests that fine-tuning has shifted model’s focus to the stance instruction, but given the associated increase in semi-hard negative retrieval, this likely came at the cost of accurately representing the topic. This is corroborated by the full RCS distribution visualised in Figure5，它显示了微调模型的下尾明显更重（参见附录, which shows a substantially heavier lower tail for the fine-tuned model (see AppendixF了解更多相关数据）。单独的单词消融热图，例如附录中的示例for more related figures). Individual word-ablation heatmaps, such as the example in AppendixG，提供立场与主题权衡的额外可视化，演示模型如何将焦点从主题名词转移到立场动词。, provide additional visualisation of the stance-topic trade-off, demonstrating how models shift focus from topical nouns to stance verbs.

这些发现表明，过度关注立场可能不利于评估主题相关性。该模型成功地学会了检索攻击论点，但在表示被攻击的主张主题方面失去了一些精度。我们将这种故障模式称为These findings suggest that undue focus on stance may be detrimental to assessing topical relevance. The model successfully learns to retrieve attacking arguments but loses some precision in representing the topic of the claim being attacked. We refer to this failure mode as the局部塌陷topical collapse.

5 立场感知检索的有针对性的干预措施Targeted Interventions for Stance-Aware Retrieval

5.1 基本原理Rationale

节中的分析The analysis in Section4.2确定虽然对比微调成功地迫使双编码器考虑指令约束，但它无意中触发了局部崩溃。我们假设这是由于使用的数据混合造成的，嵌入空间由优化压力决定，以区分正样本和硬负样本。这种压力可能会导致干扰established that while contrastive fine-tuning successfully forces the bi-encoder to account for instruction constraints, it inadvertently triggers topical collapse. We hypothesise this is due to the used data mixture, with the embedding space shaped by the optimisation pressure to differentiate between the positive and hard negative samples. This pressure may result in interferenceMcCloskey and Cohen (1989)，降低了模型准确表示语义主题的能力，这是对立场变得更加敏感的副产品。此外，训练可能会受到训练集中的虚假模式的负面影响，因为正面和硬负面文档通常共享相似的词汇和主题。因此，我们认为增加训练数据的语义多样性并减少这些虚假差异可能会减轻主题崩溃。, reducing the ability of the model to accurately represent the semantic topic as a by-product of becoming more sensitive to the stance. Additionally, the training may be negatively affected by spurious patterns in the training set, as positive and hard-negative documents commonly share similar vocabulary and thematic subject matter. Therefore, we posit that increasing the semantic diversity of the training data and reducing these spurious differences may mitigate topical collapse.

5.2 以数据为中心的干预措施Data-Centric Interventions

混合数据集Mixed Dataset基线同质课程中的三重否定仅由硬否定组成The triplet negatives in the baseline, homogeneous curriculum consisted solely of hard negatives(Dhn)(D_{\text{hn}})。为了测试这种严格同质的训练数据是否会导致主题崩溃，我们引入了“混合”课程。在此分布中，负样本空间与三分之一的硬负样本均等划分. To test whether this strictly homogeneous training data caused topical collapse, we introduce a ‘mixed’ curriculum. In this distribution, the negative sample space is partitioned equally with one-third hard negatives(Dhn)(D_{\text{hn}})，三分之一半硬底片, one-third semi-hard negatives(Dshn)(D_{\text{shn}})和三分之一的简单负面and one-third easy negatives(Den)(D_{\text{en}})。为了隔离数据分布的影响，三元组的数量固定在基线上限 31,800。重新引入. To isolate the effect of the data distribution, the number of triplets was fixed at the baseline ceiling of 31,800. ReintroducingDshnD_{\text{shn}}迫使模型保持其主题敏感性。forces the model to preserve its topical sensitivity.

立场倒置论证增强Stance-Inverted Argument Augmentation虽然混合课程缓解了主题崩溃，但其余的While the mixed curriculum mitigates topical collapse, the remainingDhnD_{\text{hn}}与正面文档相比，三元组仍然具有不同的句子结构和词汇模式（triplets still possess different sentence structures and lexical patterns compared to the positive documents (DposD_{\text{pos}}）。为了防止优化器利用这些虚假差异，我们生成合成的、立场反转的硬否定，以确保几乎相同的句子结构和大量的词汇重叠。然而，天真地促使法学硕士颠倒论点会带来新的风险。例如，简单地否定论点可能会使它们与现实世界的知识不一致。预先训练的嵌入模型，特别是基于生成主干的嵌入模型，可以识别这种不一致并将其用作虚假信号。). To prevent the optimiser from exploiting these spurious differences, we generate synthetic, stance-inverted hard negatives to ensure near-identical sentence structure and substantial lexical overlap. However, naively prompting an LLM to invert an argument introduces new risks. For example, simply negating the arguments may make them inconsistent with real-world knowledge. Pre-trained embedding models, particularly those based on generative backbones, may identify such inconsistencies and use them as a spurious signal.

为了构建有用的合成硬底片，我们的生成管道使用“让步和切断”策略。生成的法学硕士承认任何事实知识，但综合切断与目标主张的因果联系，同时最大限度地减少词汇差异。为了实现这一点，Gemini 3.5 Flash 被指示使用一次性提示生成候选姿势反转。完整提示见附录To construct helpful synthetic hard negatives, our generation pipeline uses a ‘concede and sever’ strategy. The generating LLM concedes any factual knowledge, but synthetically severs the causal link to the target claim while minimising lexical differences. To operationalise this, Gemini 3.5 Flash was instructed to generate candidate stance inversions using a one-shot prompt. The complete prompt is provided in AppendixH。然后，我们用合成对应物替换了混合课程中 50% 的自然硬否定。的. We then replaced 50% of the natural hard negatives in the mixed curriculum with their synthetic counterparts. TheDshnD_{\text{shn}}和andDenD_{\text{en}}数据部分保持不变。data portions were left unchanged.

为了验证这种方法，我们测量了单词级 Jaccard 相似度。标准参数对的平均重叠度仅为 0.0938。相比之下，我们的合成对达到了 0.5866（NLTK 词形还原为 0.5896）。虽然这没有达到生成提示中指定的 90% 目标，但这种差异很可能是 Jaccard 度量（交集与并集）的结果。即使添加几个单词来颠倒立场也会严重影响分数。尽管如此，这种六倍的增长证实了词汇相似参数的成功生成。To validate this approach, we measured word-level Jaccard similarity. Standard argument pairs exhibited an average overlap of just 0.0938. In contrast, our synthetic pairs achieved 0.5866 (0.5896 with NLTK lemmatisation). While this falls short of the 90% target specified in the generation prompt, the discrepancy is likely an artefact of the Jaccard metric (intersection over union). Adding even a few words to invert the stance heavily penalises the score. Nonetheless, this six-fold increase confirms the successful generation of lexically similar arguments.

5.3 混合搜索Hybrid Search

虽然以数据为中心的干预措施试图提高密集编码器平衡主题和立场的能力，但向量嵌入本质上难以与罕见的特定领域实体（例如 ArgTumour 数据集中的复杂医学术语）进行词汇匹配。为了解决这个问题，我们实施了基于“责任分工”的混合搜索管道。我们将经过调整的密集检索器与传统的稀疏词汇检索器（利用本地 TF-IDF 的 BM25）融合。由于稀疏模型擅长词汇锚定，但完全是立场盲的，而调整后的密集模型擅长关系立场逻辑，因此将它们结合起来旨在产生更稳健的检索。我们利用相对分数融合（RSF）和保守的稀疏加权While the data-centric interventions attempt to improve the dense encoder’s ability to balance topic and stance, vector embeddings inherently struggle with lexical matching for rare, domain-specific entities, such as complex medical terms in the ArgTumour dataset. To address this, we implemented a hybrid search pipeline based on a ‘division of responsibility’. We fuse our tuned dense retriever with a traditional sparse lexical retriever (BM25 utilising local TF-IDF). Because the sparse model excels at lexical anchoring but is entirely stance-blind, and the tuned dense model excels at relational stance logic, combining them aims to result in more robust retrieval. We utilised Relative Score Fusion (RSF) with a conservative sparse weighting(λ∈[0.1,0.15,0.2])(\lambda\in[0.1,0.15,0.2])。这种配置允许 BM25 组件充当轻量级主题过滤器，同时严重依赖调整的双编码器来进行姿态约束。. This configuration allows the BM25 component to act as a lightweight topical filter while heavily relying on the tuned bi-encoder for stance constraints.

7 结论Conclusion

在本文中，我们诊断并解决了基础嵌入模型在论证检索过程中无法平衡主题内容与方向立场的问题。基线评估证实，模型最初表现出严重的主题偏差，无视说明中的立场限制。虽然对同质的硬否定课程进行对比微调可以提高立场敏感性，但它也会降低模型正确表示主题的能力，从而导致In this paper, we diagnosed and addressed the inability of base embedding models to balance topical subject matter with directional stance during argument retrieval. Baseline evaluations confirmed that models initially exhibit a severe topic bias, disregarding stance constraints in the instructions. While contrastive fine-tuning on a homogeneous curriculum of hard negatives improves stance sensitivity, it can also degrade the ability of models to correctly represent the topic, resulting in局部塌陷topical collapse.

为了解决这种崩溃，我们提出了一个以数据为中心的两阶段管道。平衡的课程提高了所有评估架构的主题敏感性，而综合立场倒置则减少了残留的词汇捷径。事实证明，这种方法对于 Qwen3-Embedding-8B 特别有效，提高了其联合编码立场和主题相关性的能力以及整体检索性能。此外，集成 BM25 稀疏检索器提供了额外的局部安全网，修补了密集模型在高度专业化领域中剩余的盲点。To resolve this collapse, we proposed a two-stage data-centric pipeline. A balanced curriculum increased topical sensitivity across all evaluated architectures, while synthetic stance inversions reduced residual lexical shortcuts. This approach proved particularly effective for Qwen3-Embedding-8B, improving its ability to jointly encode stance and topical relevance as well as the overall retrieval performance. Furthermore, integrating a BM25 sparse retriever provided an additional topical safety net, patching the dense model’s remaining blind spots in highly specialised domains.

未来的工作可以进一步探索我们的调整模型在大型文本语料库中的论证挖掘或论证性事实验证中的应用（例如，本着Future work could further explore applications of our tuned models to argument mining from large text corpora or for argumentative fact verification (e.g., in the spirit ofFreedman et al. (2025); Zhu et al. (2025)）。此外，虽然我们以数据为中心的范式在抵消主题崩溃方面相当有效，但未来的研究可以探索以模型为中心的干预措施，例如注意力引导，以进一步提高性能。最后，探索动态调整权重因子将会很有趣). Additionally, while our data-centric paradigm was reasonably effective at counteracting topical collapse, future research could explore model-centric interventions, such as attention steering, to further improve performance. Finally, it would be interesting to explore dynamically adapting the weighting factorλ\lambda在我们的混合搜索管道中特定查询或语料库。in our hybrid search pipeline to specific queries or corpora.

附录CAppendix C实验细节Experimental Details

本节概述了我们实验期间使用的硬件、超参数和数据集统计数据。This section outlines the hardware, hyperparameters, and dataset statistics utilised during our experiments.

硬件Hardware

模型训练和推理分布在两个高性能计算集群中。实验使用了帝国理工 HPC 集群上托管的 L40S GPU 以及计算系 (Doc) GPU 集群上托管的 A40 GPU。Model training and inference were distributed across two high-performance compute clusters. Experiments utilised L40S GPUs hosted on the Imperial College HPC Cluster, as well as A40 GPUs hosted on the Department of Computing (Doc) GPU Cluster.

训练超参数Training Hyperparameters

所有微调实验均使用 Multiple Negatives Ranking Loss (MNRL) 进行优化All fine-tuning experiments were optimised using Multiple Negatives Ranking Loss (MNRL)Henderson et al. (2017)。模型训练了 2 个 epoch，每设备批量大小为 8，梯度累积步长为 2。优化过程使用的学习率为. The models were trained for 2 epochs with a per-device batch size of 8 and a gradient accumulation step of 2. The optimisation process utilised a learning rate of2×10−52\times 10^{-5}预热比率为 0.1。根据架构的不同，训练使用 FP16 或 BF16 精度。对于随机种子，训练代码依赖于 Transformers 库提供的标准默认初始化，并在批量采样器级别处理动态声明洗牌。with a warmup ratio of 0.1. Depending on the architecture, training utilised either FP16 or BF16 precision. For random seeds, the training code relied on the standard default initialisation provided by the Transformers library, with dynamic claim shuffling handled at the batch-sampler level.

附录GAppendix G文字消融热图Word-Ablation Heatmap

字级消融热图提供了局部塌陷现象的直接、视觉确认。图Word-level ablation heatmaps provide a direct, visual confirmation of the topical collapse phenomenon. Figure8在 Qwen3-Embedding-8B 的基础和调优（同质）变体上隔离特定查询实例（“检索反驳证据”+“威廉·莎士比亚是真实的……”），以说明微调后表征能力如何重新分配。在基本模型中，姿态动词“反驳”施加的影响不一致且通常很小，证实了基线教学的盲目性。isolates a specific query instance (“Retrieve evidence disproving” + “William Shakespeare is the real…”) on base and tuned (homogeneous) variants of Qwen3-Embedding-8B to illustrate how representational capacity is redistributed after fine-tuning. In the base model, the stance verb “disproving” exerts inconsistent and frequently minimal influence, confirming baseline instruction blindness.

相反，调整后的模型会导致增量值发生显着变化。指令动词“反驳”变成了一个突出的、高对比度的锚点，严厉惩罚违反立场的文件，同时将正确的文件拉近。然而，这种过度固定是以直接牺牲声明的语义锚为代价的。主题名词的影响力降至接近于零，从视觉上证实了宏观层面的 RIS/RCS 变化。最终，该模型成功地学会了执行“反驳”约束，但代价是降低了其验证底层主题的能力。Conversely, the tuned model causes a significant shift in the delta values. The instruction verb “disproving” transforms into a salient, high-contrast anchor, heavily penalising stance-violating documents while pulling correct ones closer. However, this hyper-fixation comes at the direct expense of the claim’s semantic anchors. The influence of the topical nouns collapses to near-zero, visually corroborating the macro-level RIS/RCS shifts. Ultimately, the model successfully learns to enforce the “disproving” constraint but at the cost of reducing its ability to verify the underlying subject matter.

说明Instruction: 检索反驳证据: Retrieve evidence disproving

索赔Claim：威廉·莎士比亚是所有由他创作的戏剧的真正作者。: William Shakespeare is the real author of all the plays attributed to him.

积极（攻击性）论点Positive (Attacking) Arguments:

  • •

    这种说法是错误的，因为斯特拉特福人（一位外省商人）的已知生活与剧中详细介绍的法律、外语、宫廷政治和贵族追求的广泛专业知识之间存在重大差异。The claim is false because there is a major discrepancy between the known life of the Stratford man—a provincial businessman—and the vast, expert knowledge of law, foreign languages, court politics, and aristocratic pursuits detailed in the plays.

  • •

    这种说法是错误的，因为对于那个时代最多产的作家来说，完全缺乏文学论文记录；从未在他的图书馆中发现任何私人信件、手稿或书籍，这是极不可能的。The claim is false because for the most prolific writer of the age, there is a complete lack of a literary paper trail; no personal letters, manuscripts, or books from his library have ever been found, which is highly improbable.

  • •

    这种说法是错误的，因为莎士比亚的详细遗嘱没有提及任何文学资产，例如个人书籍、正在创作的戏剧或手稿，这对于专业作家来说是令人费解的遗漏。The claim is false because Shakespeare’s detailed will makes no mention whatsoever of any literary assets, such as personal books, plays in progress, or manuscripts, an inexplicable omission for a professional writer.

  • •

    这种说法是错误的，因为莎士比亚幸存的六个签名摇摇欲坠且不一致，看起来更像是一个几乎不识字的人的潦草潦草，而不是文学大师的手。The claim is false because the six surviving signatures of Shakespeare are shaky and inconsistent, appearing more like the labored scrawl of a barely literate person than the hand of a literary master.

  • •

    声称他创作了“所有”戏剧的说法是错误的，因为现代文本分析提供了强有力的证据，表明包括《泰特斯·安德洛尼克斯》和《亨利八世》在内的几部戏剧是合作的，这意味着他不是唯一的作者。The claim’s assertion that he authored ‘all’ the plays is false because modern textual analysis provides strong evidence that several plays, including ‘Titus Andronicus’ and ‘Henry VIII,’ were collaborations, meaning he was not the sole author.

  • •

    这种说法是错误的，因为其他候选人，例如牛津伯爵爱德华·德维尔，拥有精英教育、旅行经验和对宫廷生活的深入了解，这些都在戏剧中得到了一致和准确的反映，使他们更符合作者的个人资料。The claim is false because alternative candidates, such as Edward de Vere, Earl of Oxford, possessed the elite education, travel experience, and intimate knowledge of court life that are consistently and accurately reflected in the plays, making them a more plausible match for the author’s profile.

硬否定（支持）论点Hard Negative (Supporting) Arguments:

  • •

    这种说法是正确的，因为莎士比亚的名字被印在他生前出版的许多戏剧的扉页上，在莎士比亚和作品之间建立了直接的、公开的联系。The claim is true because Shakespeare’s name was printed on the title pages of numerous plays published during his lifetime, establishing a direct, public link between the man and the works.

  • •

    这种说法是正确的，因为莎士比亚的朋友和演员同伴本·琼森、约翰·海明格和亨利·康德尔在其戏剧的权威合集《第一对开本》中明确指出他是作者。他们私下认识他，没有理由继续欺诈。The claim is true because Shakespeare’s friends and fellow actors, Ben Jonson, John Heminge, and Henry Condell, explicitly identified him as the author in the First Folio, the definitive collection of his plays. They knew him personally and would have had no reason to perpetuate a fraud.

  • •

    这一说法是真实的，因为财务和法律记录证实，斯特拉特福的威廉·莎士比亚是拥有和表演戏剧的公司的股东和主要演员，将他与作品业务直接联系起来。The claim is true because financial and legal records confirm that William Shakespeare of Stratford was a shareholder and leading actor in the company that owned and performed the plays, directly connecting the man to the business of the works.

  • •

    这一说法是正确的，因为在莎士比亚的一生中以及他死后的两个世纪里，没有人对他的作者身份表示任何怀疑。另类作者的想法是一种现代理论，没有任何当代证据的支持。The claim is true because no one during Shakespeare’s life or for two centuries after his death expressed any doubt about his authorship. The idea of an alternative author is a modern theory unsupported by any contemporary evidence.

  • •

    这种说法是正确的，因为莎士比亚在斯特拉特福接受的文法学校教育为拉丁语、修辞学和古典文学奠定了严格的基础，这足以解释戏剧中的知识，而不需要大学学位或贵族出身。The claim is true because Shakespeare’s grammar school education in Stratford would have provided a rigorous foundation in Latin, rhetoric, and classical literature, which is sufficient to explain the knowledge in the plays without requiring a university degree or noble birth.

  • •

    这种说法是正确的，因为反对他的作者身份的论点往往植根于阶级主义势利，认为平民或“格洛弗的儿子”不可能拥有这样的天才，这是对创造力的假设，而不是事实。The claim is true because arguments against his authorship are often rooted in classist snobbery, presuming that a commoner or a ‘glover’s son’ could not possess such genius, which is an assumption about creative ability, not a fact.

附录HAppendix H姿势反转提示Stance Inversion Prompt

提示提交给 Gemini 3.5 Flash 以生成现有参数的立场反转变体：Prompt submitted to Gemini 3.5 Flash to generate stance-inverted variants of existing arguments:
您是一位 NLP 数据工程师专家，负责为对比学习数据集生成“综合立场反转”。您的目标是获取支持（或攻击）某个主张的人工编写的文档，并将其重写以明确反转其立场。You are an expert NLP data engineer tasked with generating “Synthetic Stance-Inversions” for a contrastive learning dataset. Your goal is to take a human-written document that supports (or attacks) a claim and rewrite it to explicitly REVERSE its stance.

关键限制：CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS:

  1. 1.

    最小编辑距离：Minimum Edit Distance:您必须与原文保持 90% 以上的词汇重叠。保持所有名词、历史实体、主语和句子结构完全相同。You must maintain a 90%+ proportional lexical overlap with the original text. Keep all nouns, historical entities, subjects, and sentence structures completely identical.

  2. 2.

    关系翻转：The Relational Flip:您只能改变关系动词、极性形容词或连词来反转论证极性。You must ONLY alter the relational verbs, polarity adjectives, or conjunctions to reverse the argumentative polarity.

  3. 3.

    事实完整性（无幻觉）：Factual Integrity (No Hallucinations):不要编造虚假的历史事实或腐败的实体知识（例如，不要说和平活动家讨厌和平）。相反，切断因果关系（例如，“缺乏证据并不能反驳……”）。Do not invent false historical facts or corrupt entity knowledge (e.g., do not say a peace activist hated peace). Instead, sever the causal link (e.g., “absence of evidence does not disprove…”).

  4. 4.

    没有解释性的膨胀：No Explanatory Bloat:严禁你发明新的理由、合理化解释或结论性条款。不解释You are strictly forbidden from inventing new reasons, rationalisations, or concluding clauses. Do not explain为什么why该说法是假/真。简单地否定现有的因果关系。the claim is false/true. Simply negate the existing causal link.

  5. 5.

    语义多样性（无惰性否定）：Semantic Diversity (No Lazy Negation):不要仅仅依赖在动词前插入“not”或“does not”，因为这会产生逻辑悖论和脆弱的语法。使用语义反义词或直接动词倒装。不要过度依赖“尽管”模板。Do not rely exclusively on inserting “not” or “does not” before a verb, as this creates logical paradoxes and brittle syntax. Use semantic antonyms or direct verb inversions. Do not over-rely on “Although” templates.

  6. 6.

    输出格式：Output Format:您必须输出包含新文本的严格有效的 JSON。You must output strictly valid JSON containing the new text.

示例EXAMPLE

  • •

    索赔：Claim:亚特兰蒂斯是一个真正的、技术先进的文明。Atlantis was a real, technologically advanced civilization.

  • •

    原始文件：Original Document:这种说法是错误的，因为完全没有考古证据（例如废墟、工具、陶器或铭文）来支持公元前 9000 年存在一个大型、技术先进的文明。The claim is false because there is a complete absence of archaeological evidence—such as ruins, tools, pottery, or inscriptions—to support the existence of a large, technologically advanced civilization in 9,000 BCE.

  • •

    输出：Output:

    • –

      攻击翻转：attack_flipped:[“这一说法是正确的，因为完全没有考古证据——例如废墟、工具、陶器或铭文——无法明确证明公元前 9000 年存在一个大型、技术先进的文明。”][“The claim is true because a complete absence of archaeological evidence—such as ruins, tools, pottery, or inscriptions—fails to definitively disprove the existence of a large, technologically advanced civilization in 9,000 BCE.”]

你的任务YOUR TASK您将获得给定声明的支持列表和攻击列表，并且应返回 support_flipped 和 Attack_flipped 列表。You will be given a list of support and a list of attack for a given claim and should return the support_flipped and the attack_flipped lists.
